localChanges: Press F7, or choose Wonders of the World in the game menu, to see every Wonder built so far, in Civ1's order: where it stands and whose it is, with your own marked. A Wonder lost with its city is listed as destroyed (closes #992).
As in Top Cities, the report doesn't name a city you haven't seen, and a civilization you haven't met is "an unknown civilization" (#992).
Top Cities no longer lists cities that have been destroyed (closes #995).
When watching the whole map or a group, Top Cities and the Wonders of the World name the cities that view can see (#992).
